description: Process a new patient intake from demographic collection through provider assignment.

steps.description: Collect demographic and insurance information from the patient.

inputs.name: patient-name
inputs.desc: Full legal name of the patient

outputs.name: demographic-record
outputs.desc: Structured demographic data

outputs.name: insurance-details
outputs.desc: Payer, policy number, group number

process: Collect name, date of birth, gender, and address.
Record primary and secondary insurance information.
Capture emergency contact details.

steps.description: Gather the patient's medical history and current medications.

outputs.name: medical-history
outputs.desc: Past medical, surgical, and family history

outputs.name: medication-list
outputs.desc: Current medications with doses and frequency

process: Record past medical and surgical history.
Document family medical history.
List all current medications including OTC and supplements.

steps.description: Document allergies and adverse drug reactions.

inputs.name: medication-list
inputs.desc: Current medications with doses and frequency

outputs.name: allergy-list
outputs.desc: Documented allergies with severity and reaction type

outputs.name: interaction-flags
outputs.desc: Potential medication-allergy interactions

process: Record each allergy with the specific reaction.
Classify severity (mild, moderate, severe, life-threatening).
Cross-check against current medications for interactions.

steps.description: Collect vital signs and the chief complaint.

inputs.name: medical-history
inputs.desc: Past medical, surgical, and family history

outputs.name: vital-signs
outputs.desc: BP, HR, temp, respiratory rate, SpO2, weight, height

outputs.name: chief-complaint
outputs.desc: Reason for the visit in the patient's words

process: Measure and record all vital signs.
Document the chief complaint and history of present illness.
Note the onset, duration, and severity of symptoms.

steps.description: Verify insurance eligibility and benefits.

inputs.name: chief-complaint
inputs.desc: Reason for the visit in the patient's words

outputs.name: eligibility-status
outputs.desc: Active, inactive, or pending verification

outputs.name: benefit-summary
outputs.desc: Copay, deductible, and coverage details

process: Submit eligibility query to the payer.
Confirm active coverage and effective dates.
Document copay, deductible, and authorization requirements.

steps.description: Assign the patient to a provider based on availability and clinical need.

outputs.name: assigned-provider
outputs.desc: Name and specialty of the assigned provider

outputs.name: intake-record
outputs.desc: Complete intake record ready for the provider

process: Match the chief complaint to provider specialty.
Check provider availability.
Assign and notify the provider with the intake summary.

description: Develop a treatment plan from diagnosis review through follow-up scheduling.

steps.description: Review the diagnosis and clinical findings.

inputs.name: patient-record
inputs.desc: Current clinical record including labs and imaging

inputs.name: diagnosis-codes
inputs.desc: ICD-10 codes for the current diagnoses

outputs.name: clinical-summary
outputs.desc: Summary of findings supporting the diagnosis

outputs.name: severity-assessment
outputs.desc: Severity classification of the condition

process: Review lab results, imaging, and exam findings.
Confirm the diagnosis against clinical criteria.
Classify the severity and stage of the condition.

steps.description: Identify short-term and long-term treatment goals.

outputs.name: short-term-goals
outputs.desc: Goals achievable within weeks to months

outputs.name: long-term-goals
outputs.desc: Goals for sustained health improvement

process: Define measurable short-term goals (symptom relief, stabilization).
Define long-term goals (disease management, functional recovery).
Align goals with patient preferences and values.

steps.description: Select interventions based on clinical guidelines and evidence.

outputs.name: intervention-list
outputs.desc: Selected medications, procedures, therapies, and referrals

outputs.name: evidence-citations
outputs.desc: Guideline references supporting each intervention

process: Review clinical practice guidelines for the condition.
Select first-line and alternative interventions.
Document the evidence supporting each selection.

steps.description: Discuss treatment options with the patient using shared decision-making.

outputs.name: patient-preferences
outputs.desc: Patient's stated preferences and concerns

outputs.name: agreed-plan
outputs.desc: Mutually agreed treatment approach

process: Present the options with risks, benefits, and alternatives.
Elicit the patient's values, preferences, and concerns.
Reach a shared decision and document consent.

steps.description: Document the treatment plan with measurable objectives.

outputs.name: treatment-plan-document
outputs.desc: Formal treatment plan with objectives and timelines

outputs.name: order-set
outputs.desc: Orders for medications, labs, and referrals

process: Write the treatment plan with SMART objectives.
Include the medication regimen, therapy schedule, and monitoring plan.
Generate the order set for implementation.

steps.description: Schedule follow-up assessments to track progress.

outputs.name: followup-schedule
outputs.desc: Dates and types of follow-up visits

outputs.name: monitoring-checklist
outputs.desc: What to assess at each follow-up

process: Determine follow-up intervals based on the condition and treatment.
Schedule appointments and any required lab work.
Provide the patient with the schedule and preparation instructions.

description: Reconcile medications at a care transition to prevent errors.

steps.description: Collect the current medication list from all available sources.

outputs.name: source-med-lists
outputs.desc: Medication lists from patient, pharmacy, and EHR

outputs.name: source-discrepancies
outputs.desc: Differences noted between sources

process: Pull the medication list from the EHR.
Obtain a list from the patient or caregiver.
Request a medication history from the pharmacy.

steps.description: Compare the collected lists against admission or transfer orders.

inputs.name: current-orders
inputs.desc: Active medication orders at the receiving facility

outputs.name: discrepancy-list
outputs.desc: All identified discrepancies with classification

outputs.name: matched-medications
outputs.desc: Medications confirmed as consistent across sources

process: Align medications by name, dose, route, and frequency.
Flag omissions, duplications, and dose differences.
Classify each discrepancy by type and clinical significance.

steps.description: Check for drug-drug and drug-allergy interactions.

outputs.name: interaction-alerts
outputs.desc: Identified interactions with severity ratings

outputs.name: allergy-conflicts
outputs.desc: Medications conflicting with documented allergies

process: Run the combined list through the interaction database.
Flag clinically significant interactions by severity.
Check each medication against the allergy list.

steps.description: Resolve each discrepancy with the prescribing provider.

outputs.name: resolved-actions
outputs.desc: Decision for each discrepancy (continue, modify, discontinue)

outputs.name: clinical-rationale
outputs.desc: Documented reason for each decision

process: Present each discrepancy to the prescriber with context.
Obtain a decision: continue, modify, or discontinue.
Document the clinical rationale for each resolution.

steps.description: Update the official medication list with all resolutions.

outputs.name: reconciled-med-list
outputs.desc: Final reconciled medication list

outputs.name: change-summary
outputs.desc: Summary of all changes made during reconciliation

process: Apply each resolution to the medication list.
Update the EHR with the reconciled list.
Generate a change summary for the medical record.

steps.description: Communicate medication changes to the patient.

outputs.name: patient-med-card
outputs.desc: Patient-friendly medication card with instructions

outputs.name: communication-record
outputs.desc: Documentation that the patient was informed

process: Explain each change in plain language.
Provide a printed or digital medication card.
Confirm patient understanding with teach-back.

description: Review clinical documentation for completeness, accuracy, and coding compliance.

steps.description: Check documentation against ICD-10 and CPT coding requirements.

inputs.name: assigned-codes
inputs.desc: ICD-10 and CPT codes assigned to the encounter

outputs.name: coding-gaps
outputs.desc: Codes lacking sufficient documentation support

outputs.name: supported-codes
outputs.desc: Codes with adequate clinical evidence

process: Map each assigned code to its documentation requirements.
Check that the clinical notes contain the required elements.
Flag codes that lack specificity or supporting detail.

steps.description: Verify that each diagnosis is supported by clinical findings.

outputs.name: evidence-map
outputs.desc: Each diagnosis linked to its supporting evidence

outputs.name: unsupported-diagnoses
outputs.desc: Diagnoses without adequate clinical support

process: Link each diagnosis to specific exam findings, labs, or imaging.
Identify diagnoses that rely on history alone without confirmation.
Flag conditions documented without meeting diagnostic criteria.

steps.description: Identify missing or ambiguous documentation.

outputs.name: gap-list
outputs.desc: List of missing elements with their location in the record

outputs.name: ambiguity-list
outputs.desc: Statements needing clarification from the provider

process: Scan for missing required sections (HPI, ROS, exam, assessment, plan).
Identify vague language that does not meet specificity requirements.
Note copy-forward errors and contradictions.

steps.description: Generate queries to the provider for clarification on documentation gaps.

outputs.name: query-set
outputs.desc: Formatted queries for the provider

outputs.name: query-tracking-log
outputs.desc: Log to track query status and responses

process: Draft each query as a specific, non-leading question.
Reference the relevant section and date of the documentation.
Route queries to the provider through the approved workflow.

steps.description: Ensure documentation meets payer-specific requirements.

outputs.name: compliance-status
outputs.desc: Pass or fail for each payer requirement

outputs.name: denial-risk-flags
outputs.desc: Items at risk of claim denial

process: Check medical necessity documentation for each service.
Verify prior authorization documentation is present.
Confirm that the level of service matches the documentation.

steps.description: Produce the documentation review report.

outputs.name: review-report
outputs.desc: Documentation review findings and recommendations

outputs.name: action-items
outputs.desc: Required corrections and their deadlines

process: Summarize findings by category (coding, evidence, compliance).
List action items with priority and responsible party.
Calculate the documentation quality score.

description: Plan and execute a patient discharge with care coordination.

steps.description: Assess the patient's readiness for discharge.

outputs.name: readiness-status
outputs.desc: Ready, not ready, or conditional

outputs.name: barriers-list
outputs.desc: Any barriers to discharge that need resolution

process: Evaluate clinical stability against discharge criteria.
Assess functional status and self-care ability.
Identify social or logistical barriers to discharge.

steps.description: Arrange post-discharge care including follow-ups and services.

inputs.name: patient-record
inputs.desc: Clinical record with diagnoses and treatment

outputs.name: followup-appointments
outputs.desc: Scheduled follow-up visits with providers

outputs.name: service-referrals
outputs.desc: Home health, rehab, or other service arrangements

process: Schedule follow-up appointments with appropriate providers.
Arrange home health, physical therapy, or skilled nursing if needed.
Coordinate durable medical equipment delivery.

steps.description: Reconcile and finalize discharge medications.

outputs.name: discharge-med-list
outputs.desc: Final discharge medication list with instructions

outputs.name: prescription-set
outputs.desc: New or changed prescriptions to be filled

process: Compare inpatient medications against pre-admission medications.
Determine which medications to continue, modify, or discontinue.
Generate new prescriptions and verify pharmacy coverage.

steps.description: Provide discharge education to the patient and caregivers.

outputs.name: education-materials
outputs.desc: Printed or digital discharge instructions

outputs.name: understanding-confirmation
outputs.desc: Documentation of patient comprehension

process: Explain the diagnosis, treatment, and expected recovery.
Review medication changes and administration instructions.
Describe warning signs that require immediate medical attention.

steps.description: Coordinate with family or caregivers for post-discharge support.

outputs.name: caregiver-plan
outputs.desc: Caregiver responsibilities and schedule

outputs.name: support-resources
outputs.desc: Community resources and contact information

process: Meet with the caregiver to review the discharge plan.
Assign responsibilities for medication management and appointments.
Provide community resource contacts for additional support.

steps.description: Schedule post-discharge follow-up communication.

outputs.name: communication-schedule
outputs.desc: Timing and method of post-discharge check-ins

outputs.name: discharge-plan-document
outputs.desc: Complete discharge plan for the medical record

process: Schedule a follow-up phone call within 48 hours of discharge.
Set up appointment reminders.
Finalize and file the discharge plan in the medical record.

description: Conduct a telemedicine visit from identity verification through visit summary.

steps.description: Verify the patient's identity and location for the telemedicine visit.

outputs.name: identity-confirmed
outputs.desc: Verification status (confirmed or failed)

outputs.name: patient-location
outputs.desc: State or jurisdiction where the patient is located

process: Verify identity using date of birth and another identifier.
Confirm the patient's physical location for licensing compliance.
Document the verification in the encounter record.

steps.description: Confirm informed consent for the telehealth visit.

outputs.name: consent-status
outputs.desc: Consent obtained, declined, or previously on file

outputs.name: consent-record
outputs.desc: Signed or verbal consent documentation

process: Explain the nature of the telehealth visit and its limitations.
Inform the patient about privacy, recording, and data handling.
Obtain and document verbal or electronic consent.

steps.description: Conduct the clinical assessment via video.

outputs.name: assessment-findings
outputs.desc: Clinical findings from the video exam

outputs.name: patient-reported-symptoms
outputs.desc: Symptoms described by the patient

process: Review the chief complaint and history of present illness.
Conduct the examination within the limits of video.
Document observable findings and patient-reported information.

steps.description: Document the telemedicine encounter in the EHR.

outputs.name: encounter-note
outputs.desc: Complete encounter documentation

outputs.name: billing-codes
outputs.desc: CPT and modifier codes for the telehealth visit

process: Write the encounter note with telehealth-specific documentation.
Apply the correct telehealth CPT codes and modifiers.
Note the technology platform used and any technical issues.

steps.description: Place medication orders or lab/imaging orders as needed.

outputs.name: prescription-orders
outputs.desc: Medications prescribed during the visit

outputs.name: diagnostic-orders
outputs.desc: Labs, imaging, or referrals ordered

process: Prescribe medications through e-prescribing.
Order labs or imaging at a facility near the patient.
Generate referrals as needed.

steps.description: Provide the patient with a visit summary.

outputs.name: visit-summary
outputs.desc: Patient-friendly summary of the visit

outputs.name: telemedicine-encounter-record
outputs.desc: Complete record for the chart

process: Generate a patient-friendly summary of the diagnosis and plan.
Include medication instructions and follow-up information.
Send the summary through the patient portal.

description: Interpret laboratory results and communicate findings to the patient.

steps.description: Receive and parse the lab report.

outputs.name: parsed-results
outputs.desc: Structured lab values with test names and units

outputs.name: report-metadata
outputs.desc: Lab name, collection time, specimen type

process: Receive the lab report from the interface or fax.
Parse each test result into structured data.
Record the collection time, specimen type, and performing lab.

steps.description: Compare each value against the reference range.

outputs.name: flagged-values
outputs.desc: Values outside reference ranges with direction (high or low)

outputs.name: normal-values
outputs.desc: Values within reference ranges

process: Compare each result against age- and sex-adjusted reference ranges.
Flag values as high, low, or critical.
Note any results at the margin that may warrant attention.

steps.description: Identify and route critical or panic values.

outputs.name: critical-alerts
outputs.desc: Critical values requiring immediate action

outputs.name: urgent-values
outputs.desc: Significantly abnormal but not critical values

process: Check flagged values against the critical value list.
Route critical values to the provider for immediate notification.
Log the notification time for compliance.

steps.description: Correlate results with the patient's clinical context.

outputs.name: clinical-correlation
outputs.desc: Explanation of abnormal values in clinical context

outputs.name: trending-data
outputs.desc: Comparison with previous results for trending

process: Compare against previous results to identify trends.
Correlate abnormalities with known diagnoses and medications.
Identify values that suggest a new or worsening condition.

steps.description: Determine if additional testing is needed.

outputs.name: recommended-tests
outputs.desc: Suggested follow-up tests with rationale

outputs.name: action-plan
outputs.desc: Clinical actions based on the results

process: Evaluate whether results warrant confirmatory or follow-up testing.
Recommend additional tests based on clinical guidelines.
Define the timeline for repeat testing.

steps.description: Communicate results and the plan to the patient.

outputs.name: patient-notification
outputs.desc: Patient-friendly explanation of results

outputs.name: lab-interpretation-note
outputs.desc: Provider's interpretation note for the chart

process: Translate results into plain language for the patient.
Explain what the results mean and what happens next.
Document the communication in the medical record.

description: Implement an infection control protocol from risk identification through monitoring.

steps.description: Identify the infection risk including pathogen and transmission route.

outputs.name: risk-profile
outputs.desc: Pathogen characteristics and transmission routes

outputs.name: affected-scope
outputs.desc: Areas and personnel at risk

process: Identify the pathogen and its known transmission routes.
Determine the clinical areas and populations at risk.
Assess the severity and outbreak potential.

steps.description: Select the appropriate infection control precautions.

outputs.name: precaution-type
outputs.desc: Standard, contact, droplet, airborne, or combination

outputs.name: ppe-requirements
outputs.desc: Required personal protective equipment

process: Select precaution level based on the transmission route.
Define the required PPE for each staff interaction.
Determine room placement requirements (private, negative pressure).

steps.description: Implement environmental controls for infection prevention.

outputs.name: environmental-plan
outputs.desc: Cleaning, ventilation, and signage requirements

outputs.name: implementation-checklist
outputs.desc: Tasks to complete and verify

process: Set up enhanced cleaning schedules for affected areas.
Adjust ventilation and air handling as needed.
Post isolation signage and supply PPE at room entry.

steps.description: Train staff on PPE use and hand hygiene procedures.

outputs.name: training-completion-log
outputs.desc: Record of staff trained

outputs.name: competency-results
outputs.desc: Demonstration results for donning and doffing

process: Conduct training on correct donning and doffing procedures.
Demonstrate proper hand hygiene technique.
Assess competency through direct observation.

steps.description: Monitor compliance with infection control measures through audits.

outputs.name: audit-results
outputs.desc: Compliance rates by measure and unit

outputs.name: corrective-actions
outputs.desc: Non-compliance issues and corrective steps

process: Conduct direct observation audits of hand hygiene and PPE use.
Verify environmental cleaning compliance.
Report results and issue corrective actions for deficiencies.

steps.description: Track infection rates and produce the infection control report.

outputs.name: infection-rate-data
outputs.desc: Infection counts and rates over time

outputs.name: infection-control-plan
outputs.desc: Complete infection control plan and report

process: Track new infections by unit, pathogen, and time period.
Compare rates against baseline and national benchmarks.
Produce the infection control summary with trends and recommendations.

description: Develop a clinical pathway for a condition from evidence review through outcome measurement.

steps.description: Review the evidence base and clinical guidelines for the condition.

inputs.name: target-condition
inputs.desc: The condition or procedure for the pathway

outputs.name: evidence-summary
outputs.desc: Summary of key evidence and guideline recommendations

outputs.name: best-practice-list
outputs.desc: Evidence-based practices to incorporate

process: Search clinical guidelines from major organizations.
Review systematic reviews and meta-analyses.
Identify the highest-quality evidence for each care decision.

steps.description: Define the patient population and inclusion criteria for the pathway.

outputs.name: inclusion-criteria
outputs.desc: Criteria for patients who qualify for the pathway

outputs.name: exclusion-criteria
outputs.desc: Criteria for patients who should not follow the pathway

process: Define the diagnosis codes and clinical criteria for inclusion.
Identify patient populations that need a different approach.
Specify age, comorbidity, and severity boundaries.

steps.description: Map the care steps by day or phase.

outputs.name: pathway-map
outputs.desc: Care activities organized by timeline

outputs.name: responsible-roles
outputs.desc: Which role performs each step

process: Organize care activities into phases (pre, during, post).
Assign each activity to a timeline.
Identify the responsible discipline for each step.

steps.description: Define expected outcomes and variance tracking criteria.

outputs.name: outcome-measures
outputs.desc: Expected outcomes with target values

outputs.name: variance-criteria
outputs.desc: Conditions that constitute a variance from the pathway

process: Define the primary outcome measures (length of stay, readmission, complication rate).
Set target values based on evidence and benchmarks.
Define what constitutes a variance and how to document it.

steps.description: Pilot the pathway with a defined patient group.

outputs.name: pilot-data
outputs.desc: Outcomes and variances from the pilot period

outputs.name: staff-feedback
outputs.desc: Clinician feedback on usability and completeness

process: Implement the pathway for a pilot group of patients.
Track outcomes and variances during the pilot.
Collect staff feedback on the pathway's clinical fit and usability.

steps.description: Measure outcomes against benchmarks and produce the pathway document.

outputs.name: outcome-report
outputs.desc: Comparison of pilot outcomes to targets

outputs.name: clinical-pathway-document
outputs.desc: Finalized clinical pathway for implementation

process: Compare pilot outcomes against the defined targets.
Revise the pathway based on pilot data and feedback.
Finalize the pathway document for broad implementation.

description: Run a healthcare quality improvement project using the PDSA cycle.

steps.description: Define the aim statement and quality measures.

outputs.name: aim-statement
outputs.desc: Specific, measurable aim with timeline

outputs.name: quality-measures
outputs.desc: Process, outcome, and balancing measures

process: Write the aim statement: what, how much, by when.
Define process measures (adherence to the intervention).
Define outcome measures and balancing measures.

steps.description: Analyze the current process to identify root causes.

outputs.name: process-map
outputs.desc: Visual map of the current workflow

outputs.name: root-causes
outputs.desc: Identified root causes of the quality gap

process: Map the current process with a flowchart or value stream map.
Conduct root cause analysis (fishbone diagram, 5 Whys).
Identify the highest-impact root causes to target.

steps.description: Develop the change idea to address the root causes.

outputs.name: change-concept
outputs.desc: Description of the proposed change

outputs.name: implementation-plan
outputs.desc: Steps, timeline, and resources for the change

process: Generate change ideas based on the root causes.
Select the most feasible and impactful change.
Plan the implementation with responsible parties and timeline.

steps.description: Run the Plan-Do-Study-Act cycle.

outputs.name: cycle-results
outputs.desc: Data collected during the cycle

outputs.name: lessons-learned
outputs.desc: What worked, what did not, and why

process: Plan: define the test, predictions, and data collection.
Do: carry out the test on a small scale.
Study: analyze the results and compare to predictions.

steps.description: Measure the impact of the change.

outputs.name: impact-analysis
outputs.desc: Statistical comparison of pre and post performance

outputs.name: run-chart
outputs.desc: Time-series chart showing performance trend

process: Compare post-intervention data to baseline.
Plot a run chart to visualize the trend.
Determine if the change produced a statistically meaningful improvement.

steps.description: Scale the change or adjust based on results.

inputs.name: lessons-learned
inputs.desc: What worked and what did not

outputs.name: scale-decision
outputs.desc: Adopt, adapt, or abandon the change

outputs.name: qi-project-report
outputs.desc: Complete QI project report with recommendations

process: Decide: adopt (scale up), adapt (modify and retest), or abandon.
If scaling, plan the broader rollout.
Write the final QI report with findings and sustainability plan.

description: Verify healthcare provider credentials from application through committee review.

steps.description: Collect the credentialing application and supporting documents.

inputs.name: applicant-name
inputs.desc: Name of the provider applying for credentials

inputs.name: credential-type
inputs.desc: Initial appointment, reappointment, or privilege modification

outputs.name: application-package
outputs.desc: Completed application with all required documents

outputs.name: missing-items
outputs.desc: List of any documents not yet received

process: Send the application and document checklist to the provider.
Collect the completed application with CV, licenses, and references.
Identify and request any missing documents.

steps.description: Verify education and training credentials.

outputs.name: education-verification
outputs.desc: Confirmed degrees, residency, and fellowship training

outputs.name: discrepancy-flags
outputs.desc: Any discrepancies between claimed and verified credentials

process: Contact medical schools to verify degree completion.
Verify residency and fellowship training with programs.
Confirm any additional certifications or training.

steps.description: Verify current licensure and board certification status.

outputs.name: license-status
outputs.desc: Active, inactive, or restricted for each license

outputs.name: board-cert-status
outputs.desc: Board certification status and expiration

process: Query the state licensing board for current status and actions.
Verify board certification through the certifying body.
Check DEA registration if prescribing privileges are requested.

steps.description: Check malpractice history and disciplinary sanctions.

outputs.name: malpractice-history
outputs.desc: Claims, settlements, and judgments

outputs.name: sanction-records
outputs.desc: Disciplinary actions from any state or federal body

process: Review the provider's self-reported malpractice history.
Query malpractice insurance carriers for claims history.
Check OIG exclusion list and state disciplinary databases.

steps.description: Query the National Practitioner Data Bank.

outputs.name: npdb-results
outputs.desc: NPDB query response with any reported actions

outputs.name: reconciliation-notes
outputs.desc: Comparison of NPDB data against application disclosures

process: Submit the NPDB query with the provider's identifying information.
Review the response for malpractice payments and adverse actions.
Reconcile NPDB findings with the provider's self-disclosure.

steps.description: Present the verified file to the credentials committee.

outputs.name: committee-decision
outputs.desc: Approved, approved with conditions, deferred, or denied

outputs.name: credentialing-file
outputs.desc: Complete credentialing file with all verifications

process: Compile the complete credentialing file with all verifications.
Present the file to the credentials committee with a summary.
Record the committee's decision and any conditions.

description: Assess HIPAA compliance across administrative, physical, and technical safeguards.

steps.description: Inventory all systems that handle protected health information.

outputs.name: phi-systems
outputs.desc: Systems that create, receive, maintain, or transmit PHI

outputs.name: data-flow-map
outputs.desc: How PHI moves between systems and locations

process: Catalog all systems that store or process PHI.
Map the flow of PHI between systems, locations, and third parties.
Identify the types of PHI in each system.

steps.description: Review the HIPAA risk analysis covering all safeguard categories.

outputs.name: risk-findings
outputs.desc: Identified risks to PHI by safeguard category

outputs.name: current-controls
outputs.desc: Existing controls mapped to each risk

process: Evaluate administrative safeguards (policies, training, access management).
Evaluate physical safeguards (facility access, workstation security, device controls).
Evaluate technical safeguards (access controls, audit logs, encryption, integrity).

steps.description: Check for a current Notice of Privacy Practices and patient rights procedures.

outputs.name: npp-status
outputs.desc: Current, outdated, or missing Notice of Privacy Practices

outputs.name: patient-rights-status
outputs.desc: Compliance with patient rights requirements

process: Review the Notice of Privacy Practices for current regulatory alignment.
Check that patient rights procedures are implemented (access, amendment, accounting).
Verify that the NPP is distributed to patients at first encounter.

steps.description: Verify that business associate agreements are in place for all vendors.

outputs.name: baa-inventory
outputs.desc: List of all business associates and their BAA status

outputs.name: baa-gaps
outputs.desc: Vendors handling PHI without a current BAA

process: Identify all vendors that access, store, or transmit PHI.
Verify that each has a signed, current BAA.
Flag vendors without BAAs or with expired agreements.

steps.description: Review breach notification procedures and incident history.

outputs.name: breach-procedure-status
outputs.desc: Assessment of breach notification readiness

outputs.name: incident-history
outputs.desc: Past breach incidents and their resolution

process: Review the breach notification policy for regulatory compliance.
Verify that the breach risk assessment process is documented.
Check the log of past incidents for proper handling and reporting.

steps.description: Assess staff HIPAA training records and produce the compliance report.

outputs.name: training-compliance
outputs.desc: Staff training completion rates and gaps

outputs.name: hipaa-compliance-report
outputs.desc: Complete HIPAA compliance assessment report

process: Review training records for completion rates by department.
Identify staff who have not completed required HIPAA training.
Compile all findings into the HIPAA compliance assessment report.
